notes: Fit PARTIAL, roadmap PLANNED. STALE is computed by comparing the oldest last_read_at among the facts read with a window set by CAGE policy. Using the oldest time is the fail-closed choice: one recently read fact cannot make a stale answer look fresh. confirmed_at says when a practitioner reviewed a fact, a trust signal, and is not used as the freshness clock. Today sources are read when OpsCanvas scans them, so a window of hours or days is realistic and a window of minutes is not. Other predicate values are strict fill; CAGE must not read them because the status is not OK.
gaps: status (STALE): PARTIAL, PLANNED. Freshness is measured from when each fact's source was last read. A window of minutes needs sources read continuously, which is planned with the hosted endpoint (Q3, Q5).
ttl_seconds: NOT_AVAILABLE, PLANNED. 86400 is a policy value chosen for this example. We propose TTL set per field by policy (Q3).
